galleryPage.title: Gallery
galleryPage.description: Simulations that can be used as interactive demos of optics, for [the wave-optics simulator](/wave) and for [the ray simulator](/simulator) it was forked from. You are welcome to contribute new items. See [the contribution guide](/contributing/gallery) for more information. To report a mistake, please [open an issue on GitHub](/github/issues) or email [ray-optics@phydemo.app](/email).

waveOptics.title: Wave optics
waveOptics.description: Worked examples for the wave-optics simulator, where the light is a complex scalar field summed from point sources. Each is built to fit the window it is loaded into, so it fills whatever screen it opens on.

rayOptics.title: Ray optics
rayOptics.description: Scenes for the ray simulator this project was forked from, which traces rays rather than summing fields.

assignments.title: Assignments
assignments.description: Set pieces rather than demonstrations: each states a goal, lets you change only what the exercise is about, and scores how close you are as you work. Every one is a single self-contained page, so it can be embedded in a course platform that allows no external requests.
